quiver.definition:
n. case for holding arrows
v. shake with fast, tremulous movements
quiver.translation:
n. 震动, 颤抖, 箭袋
vi. 颤抖, 振动
vt. 使颤动
a. 敏捷的

quivered.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Quiver
a. Furnished with, or carrying, a quiver.
a. Sheathed, as in a quiver.
quivered.translation: v. 微颤, 抖动( quiver的过去式和过去分词 ); 使震动

quiverful.translation: n. 箭筒装满, 多数, 许多

quivering.definition:
n a shaky motion
n the act of vibrating
v shake with fast, tremulous movements
v move back and forth very rapidly
v move with or as if with a regular alternating motion
quivering.translation: a. 颤动的, 抖动的

quiveringly.translation: adv. 颤抖地, 震动地

quiverings.definition:
plural of quivering
n a shaky motion
n the act of vibrating
v shake with fast, tremulous movements
v move back and forth very rapidly
v move with or as if with a regular alternating motion
quiverings.translation: (quivering 的复数) a. 颤动的, 抖动的

quivers.definition:
n an almost pleasurable sensation of fright
n a shaky motion
n case for holding arrows
n the act of vibrating
v shake with fast, tremulous movements
v move back and forth very rapidly
v move with or as if with a regular alternating motion
quivers.translation: v. 微颤, 抖动( quiver的第三人称单数 ); 使震动

quivery.translation: a. 颤抖的, 震动的
